AMF Bowling World Lanes.name: AMF Bowling World Lanes
AMF Bowling World Lanes.summary: AMF Bowling World Lanes is a sports video game developed by Front Line Studios and published by Bethesda Softworks on November 18, 2008.

Just Dance 2019.name: Just Dance 2019
Just Dance 2019.summary: Just Dance 2019 is the ultimate dance game with 40 hot tracks from chart-topping hits to family favorites, including "Havana" by Camila Cabello, "Bang Bang Bang" by BIGBANG, "I Feel It Coming" by The Weeknd Ft. Daft Punk, and more!

Munchables, The.name: The Munchables
Munchables, The.summary: The player controls creatures of insatiable appetite, using their regurgitating prowess to consume an army of invading Tabemon Space Pirates, each of whom bears an uncanny resemblance to various foods.

Raving Rabbids - Travel in Time.name: Raving Rabbids: Travel in Time
Raving Rabbids - Travel in Time.summary:
Raving Rabbids: Travel in Time is a party game for the Wii in which the titular Rabbids travel back in time using a washing machine. Its various co-operative and competitive mini-games can be played alone or with 2-4 players both online and offline.
The game is centered around a museum from which the Rabbids Travel to different time periods and places. There are five main types of gameplay with a number of variations on each set in different locations and times. The games include flying, racing, fishing, shooting and 2.5D platforming.

Sonic and the Secret Rings.name: Sonic and the Secret Rings
Sonic and the Secret Rings.summary: Sonic and the Secret Rings is a three-dimensional platform and action game featuring an on-rails style of movement. Sonic the Hedgehog, the series' main character, is the game's only player character. He is controlled exclusively with the Wii Remote, which is held horizontally like a traditional gamepad.

Swing Golf Pangya 2nd Shot!.name: Super Swing Golf: Season 2
Swing Golf Pangya 2nd Shot!.summary:
Swing into action with your favorite characters

Swing into action with your favorite characters as they return to the island to challenge new courses with all new story and tournament modes.

New multiplayer modes have been introduced to keep the party going with friends and family. With completely new customizations, costumes, and secrets, Super Swing Golf Season 2 is a true hole-in-one!

Party Mode - Play new party games - "Darts" and "Driving Contest"!
New Tour Mode - Compete with rivals and progress through the game as you conquer all the island of Pangya!
Fun Courses - Choose from newly added courses to keep your golf experience fresh and exciting!
Colorful Costumes - Unlock new costumes and some classic Tecmo character costumes!

ThinkSMART - Family!.name: ThinkSmart: Family!
ThinkSMART - Family!.summary: A Puzzle Game for the whole family -Now the whole family can power up their minds and bodies And everyone can go head to head at your own level! -Over 8,000 exercises for well toned minds and bodies -Players establish their own “THINK” quotient and track their progress receiving expert evaluations throughout -Players can customize their own Avatars and enter the "Think Institute” to create their personalized daily plan -7 different categories: language comprehension, math, memory, logical and three-dimensional reasoning, readiness of mind and physical fitness -Includes puzzle games like Sudoku, Towers of Hanoi, Signal Boxes, Sort the Luggage and Mirror Image, absolutely free!" -Fun for up to 16 players in single and multi-player modes, Tournament, Competition and Endurance

Thor - God of Thunder.name: Thor: God of Thunder
Thor - God of Thunder.summary:
Thor: God of Thunder is an action-adventure game developed by Liquid Entertainment and published by Sega in 2011. It serves as a tie-in to the Thor film from the Marvel Cinematic Universe. Players control Thor as he wields Mjolnir to battle enemies across the Nine Realms, facing iconic foes such as Surtur and Ulik while protecting Asgard from destruction.

The gameplay features melee combat, elemental powers, and environmental puzzles, with some differences across platforms. The console versions (PlayStation 3, Xbox 360) emphasise 3D action, while the Nintendo 3DS and Wii versions include more stylised and simplified gameplay.

Zumba Fitness 2.name: Zumba Fitness 2
Zumba Fitness 2.summary:
Party yourself into shape!

Players can learn and perfect nine different dance styles: Reggaeton, Merengue, Salsa, Cumbia, Hip hop, Mambo, Rumba, Flamenco and Calypso as well as new routines including the Axe, Indian, Latin Pop, Bellydance and Pasodoble. led by Zumba creator Beto and celebrity instructors Gina Grant and Tanya Beardsley. New features include a calorie tracker, revamped gameplay, and graphical representations of the instructors.
